newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece skips 14-day depo tender Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece skips 14-day depo tender Wednesday.

text.p: The Bank of Greece said it would not hold its regular 14-day depo tender on Wednesday, leaving 40 billion drachmas of maturing depos to boost market liquidity.

"The Bank of Greece announces it will not conduct on Wednesday 06 August 1997 its weekly 14-day fixed rate depo tender, thus leaving 40 billion drachmas of additional liquidity to the market," it said.
The Bank of Greece also skipped last week's depo tender, adding 50 billion drachmas to the system. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
